title: The People Fear God's Voice at Sinai
description: The whole people saw the thunder and the lightning, heard the sound of the trumpet, and saw the mountain covered in smoke. They trembled and kept their distance, asking Moses to speak to them instead of God, for they feared they would die. Moses reassured them that God had come to test them, so that fear of Him would keep them from sinning. While the people stood at a distance, Moses entered the darkness where God was.
